name: maps
description: maps: places near a place (restaurants, shops of a kind, a pharmacy...) on a map with a card each, directions from A to B (walk, transit, car, bike) and your own maps with markers and routes, in a map view in the thread. OpenStreetMap with no key; Google Maps with a key in the plugin's settings. Use it when the user asks where something is, what is near, how to get somewhere, or to plan a day on a map

prompts: find good ramen near Gare de Lyon
how do I get from Bastille to the Louvre by metro?
plan my Saturday in Lyon on a map: 4 stops, walking

settings.label: Google Maps API key
settings.help: optional: ratings, opening hours, transit and Google's map. Turn on Places API (New), Routes API and Map Tiles API for the key. Without it the map uses OpenStreetMap
